context: Headless Edge, isolated local fixture. No hardware recommendation can be inferred.

checks.name: Existing terrain mesher includes elevated deck

Atlas is eight directions, four frames, three pitches
Extreme pitch uses nearest documented bake
No rendering errors after visual controls
